record.paper_title: Several Open Problems in Operator Theory
record.original_question: Fix a real number a in [0, 2), and let E_a be the class of all two-dimensional Banach spaces E with characteristic of convexity epsilon_0(E) = a, where epsilon_0(X) = sup {epsilon : delta_X(epsilon) = 0} and delta_X is the modulus of convexity. Does there exist a space E_star in E_a such that delta_E(epsilon) <= delta_E_star(epsilon) for every E in E_a and every relevant epsilon?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a Banach space $X$, define the modulus of convexity
$$\delta_X(\varepsilon)=\inf\Bigl\{1-\tfrac{\|x+y\|}{2}:\ x,y\in X,\ \|x\|=\|y\|=1,\ \|x-y\|\ge \varepsilon\Bigr\},\qquad \varepsilon\in[0,2],$$
and the characteristic of convexity
$$\varepsilon_0(X)=\sup\{\varepsilon\in[0,2]:\delta_X(\varepsilon)=0\}.$$
Fix a real number $a\in[0,2)$ and let $\mathcal{E}_a$ denote the class of all two-dimensional real Banach spaces $E$ with $\varepsilon_0(E)=a$.

Does there exist a space $E_*\in\mathcal{E}_a$ such that
$$\delta_E(\varepsilon)\le\delta_{E_*}(\varepsilon)$$
for every $E\in\mathcal{E}_a$ and every $\varepsilon\in[a,2]$?

status_evidence.title: Modulus of convexity in Banach spaces - ScienceDirect
status_evidence.snippet: General discussion of modulus of convexity, characteristic of convexity, and properties in two-dimensional Banach spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Background literature on the modulus and characteristic of convexity exists, but no extremal 'most rotund' result for fixed characteristic was located.

status_evidence.title: On Moduli of Convexity in Banach Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Survey-style discussion of moduli of convexity without resolving extremal questions for fixed characteristic.
status_evidence.claim: No source found that constructs or rules out an extremal two-dimensional space E_* maximizing delta_E among spaces with epsilon_0(E)=a.
